title: sw-dev-blueprint EM diagnosis (tasks/diagnosis.json)
description: Schema-bound verdict the EM writes when the shell orchestrator consults it after a task fails twice, or when the full frozen suite fails after all tasks passed (spec drift). The shell routes MECHANICALLY on `verdict` — the EM advises, it never drives (D-26/D-29). D-71: the model's reply surface is verdict+reason(+revised_brief) only — the orchestrator stamps task_id into the artifact itself (it knows which task it is consulting about; asking a mid-tier model to echo it back was pure transcription risk), and an invalid reply earns exactly one retry carrying the validator's errors. The orchestrator validates the stamped file with scripts/validate-plan.py --diagnosis (which still requires task_id — on the artifact, guaranteed by the stamp), consumes it, and deletes it; it is never committed.

task_id.description: The failing task id (e.g. T3), or the literal string DRIFT for a suite-red/tasks-green consult. NOT requested from the model — the orchestrator stamps it after the reply (D-71); a model-supplied value is overwritten.

verdict.description: brief_wrong: the task brief under-specified or mis-specified the work — supply revised_brief. decomposition_wrong: the task split itself is wrong (wrong file boundaries, missing task, bad dependency) — the orchestrator will ask for a plan re-emit. contract_or_test_wrong: the frozen spec (contracts.json entry or TPM test) is wrong — this escalates to the TPM as a batched bundle; `reason` becomes the evidence the human operator carries to the web chat. transient_or_environmental: the supplied evidence affirmatively identifies an external, resource, service, timing, or non-reproducible condition and does not identify a brief, decomposition, contract, or test defect — the shell halts for operator review and never retries or re-probes automatically.

reason.description: Plain-language explanation of the verdict, written to be read by the tier above (orchestrator log, or the TPM via the escalation bundle).

revised_brief.description: REQUIRED when verdict is brief_wrong: the full replacement brief (Rule 8 discipline applies). Ignored otherwise.
